001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
008import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
009
010/**
011 *
012 * @author jimmy
013 */
014public class PropSamePrefix extends Propagator<IntVar> {
015
016    private final IntVar length;
017    private final IntVar[] string1;
018    private final IntVar[] string2;
019
020    public PropSamePrefix(IntVar length, IntVar[] string1, IntVar[] string2) {
021        super(buildArray(length, string1, string2), PropagatorPriority.LINEAR, true);
022        this.length = length;
023        this.string1 = string1;
024        this.string2 = string2;
025    }
026
027    private static IntVar[] buildArray(IntVar length, IntVar[] string1, IntVar[] string2) {
028        IntVar[] array = new IntVar[1 + string1.length + string2.length];
029        array[0] = length;
030        System.arraycopy(string1, 0, array, 1, string1.length);
031        System.arraycopy(string2, 0, array, 1 + string1.length, string2.length);
032        return array;
033    }
034
035    private boolean isLengthVar(int idx) {
036        return idx == 0;
037    }
038
039    private boolean isString1Var(int idx) {
040        return idx > 0 && idx <= string1.length;
041    }
042
043    private int getString1VarIndex(int idx) {
044        return idx - 1;
045    }
046
047    private boolean isString2Var(int idx) {
048        return idx > string1.length;
049    }
050
051    private int getString2VarIndex(int idx) {
052        return idx - string1.length - 1;
053    }
054
055    private boolean neq(int i) {
056        return (string1[i].isInstantiated() && !string2[i].contains(string1[i].getValue()))
057                || (string2[i].isInstantiated() && !string1[i].contains(string2[i].getValue()));
058    }
059
060    @Override
061    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
062        length.updateUpperBound(Math.min(string1.length, string2.length), this);
063        for (int i = 0; i < length.getLB(); i++) {
064            PropUtil.domSubsetDom(string1[i], string2[i], this);
065            PropUtil.domSubsetDom(string2[i], string1[i], this);
066        }
067        for (int i = length.getLB(); i < length.getUB(); i++) {
068            if (neq(i)) {
069                length.updateUpperBound(i, this);
070                break;
071            }
072        }
073    }
074
075    @Override
076    public void propagate(int idxVarInProp, int mask) throws ContradictionException {
077        if (isLengthVar(idxVarInProp)) {
078            for (int i = 0; i < length.getLB(); i++) {
079                PropUtil.domSubsetDom(string1[i], string2[i], this);
080                PropUtil.domSubsetDom(string2[i], string1[i], this);
081            }
082        } else if (isString1Var(idxVarInProp)) {
083            int id = getString1VarIndex(idxVarInProp);
084            if (id < length.getLB()) {
085                PropUtil.domSubsetDom(string2[id], string1[id], this);
086            }
087            if (id < length.getUB() && neq(id)) {
088                length.updateUpperBound(id, this);
089            }
090        } else {
091            assert isString2Var(idxVarInProp);
092            int id = getString2VarIndex(idxVarInProp);
093            if (id < length.getLB()) {
094                PropUtil.domSubsetDom(string1[id], string2[id], this);
095            }
096            if (id < length.getUB() && neq(id)) {
097                length.updateUpperBound(id, this);
098            }
099        }
100    }
101
102    @Override
103    public ESat isEntailed() {
104        if (length.getLB() > string1.length || length.getLB() > string2.length) {
105            return ESat.FALSE;
106        }
107        boolean isCompletelyInstantiated = true;
108        for (int i = 0; i < length.getLB(); i++) {
109            if (neq(i)) {
110                return ESat.FALSE;
111            }
112            isCompletelyInstantiated = isCompletelyInstantiated
113                    && string1[i].isInstantiated() && string2[i].isInstantiated();
114        }
115        isCompletelyInstantiated = isCompletelyInstantiated && length.isInstantiated();
116        return isCompletelyInstantiated ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
117    }
118
119    @Override
120    public String toString() {
121        return "samePrefix(" + length + ", " + Arrays.toString(string1) + ", " + Arrays.toString(string2) + ")";
122    }
123}
